risk_reasons: Touches worker/background/pollers/OutboxPoller.ts — the dispatch path every async workflow in RepWorth depends on
Changes a terminal state transition on job_outbox, governed by invariant #2 (transactional outbox)
A false-positive terminalization would mark genuinely in-flight work 'failed'
goal: The Watchdog terminalizes a stale 'dispatching' Outbox job that has exhausted its attempts on every topic, not only agent_turn, so a crash between the claim and runOutboxDispatchFailure can no longer strand a row in a state no arm and no claim can select.
non_goals: Widening checkFailedOutboxJobs' 7-topic allowlist in worker/background/pollers/health-alert/checks.ts — owner decision, tracked as a separate issue
Changing the 2-minute dispatching staleness window or OUTBOX_WATCHDOG_STALE_MS
Making reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox topic-agnostic — it stays Operator-specific, gated by the array_agg(...) FILTER at OutboxPoller.ts:152
Changing claimPendingBatch, markDispatched, or the dispatch path
Backfilling existing orphans — production and staging were both queried at 2026-09-20 and hold zero matching rows
user_visible_behavior: A 'dispatching' job_outbox row at attempts >= max_attempts whose dispatched_at is NULL or older than 2 minutes becomes status='failed' with completed_at set, on any topic, within one watchdog cycle.
The '[OutboxPoller] Watchdog recovered stale entries' log line's `failed` count now includes such rows on non-agent_turn topics.
The outbox_stale_dispatching HealthAlertPoller finding, which such a row otherwise raises forever with the misleading title 'OutboxPoller watchdog may be down', now clears on the next cycle.
invariants: Invariant #2: the in-flight status set ('pending','dispatching','dispatched') owned by src/lib/shared/job-outbox-status.ts is not referenced or re-spelled by this change; ci:outbox-status stays green.
reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox is called only for terminalized rows whose topic is QUEUE_NAMES.AGENT_TURN.
A row claimed less than 2 minutes ago is never terminalized, whatever its attempts.
The #736 last_error preservation (COALESCE(NULLIF(last_error, ''), ...)) holds for both the dispatched and the dispatching branch.
Arm 2 (terminalize) and arm 3 (re-pend) stay mutually exclusive by the attempts predicate, so no row is both terminalized and re-pended in one transaction.
edge_cases: dispatched_at IS NULL is treated as stale, matching arm 3's existing predicate at OutboxPoller.ts:172.
A row at attempts >= max_attempts with dispatched_at inside 2 minutes is left untouched — this is the guard against terminalizing a row the current cycle is still dispatching.
An agent_turn row keeps its existing route through reconcileTurnForFailedOutbox, including the 'deferred' outcome that rolls the row back to 'dispatched' and subtracts from terminatedCount.
A terminalized dispatching row with NULL or empty last_error receives 'Stale dispatching entry exceeded max_attempts'; one carrying a bounded error class keeps it.
A dispatching row on a topic the queue registry does not know is still terminalized — the watchdog is deliberately topic-blind, matching the existing PROBE_TOPIC fixture.
existing_patterns_to_follow: worker/background/pollers/OutboxPoller.ts:166-176 — arm 3's topic-agnostic dispatching predicate is the exact shape the new disjunct copies
worker/background/pollers/__tests__/OutboxPoller.watchdog.integration.test.ts — the live-DB seam, PROBE_TOPIC fixture, seedRow/rowState helpers and interval-based ageing
worker/background/pollers/__tests__/OutboxPoller.operator.integration.test.ts — the agent_turn terminalizer's live-DB coverage that must stay green

rollback_plan: Revert the single commit. The predicate returns to topic-scoped and no schema or data migration is involved, so the revert is complete. Rows the new arm already terminalized stay 'failed'; they were permanently unrecoverable before the change, so leaving them terminal is the desired end state and needs no compensating write.
observability: Structured log '[OutboxPoller] Watchdog recovered stale entries' — the `failed` field counts the new terminalizations.
HealthAlertPoller finding outbox_stale_dispatching (threshold HEALTH_ALERT_STALE_DISPATCHING_S, default 600s) clears instead of firing permanently.

Named gap: checkFailedOutboxJobs pages only for 7 allowlisted topics, so a terminalized row on any other topic is correct in job_outbox but does not page. Tracked by the follow-up issue this run files.
